newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen consolidating before rise.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen consolidating before rise.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures are expected to consolidate at current levels in the short term before attempting higher in the longer term, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
Traders called the market to open two stg down after slight losses in New York on Tuesday on speculative long liquidation. But trading was listless.
London's cocoa futures were also lower in a sluggish session on Tuesday.
But traders tried to remain hopeful that a breakout would come soon. They said rangebound trade and lack of volatility was usually a sign that a big move was imminent.
Benchmark July was seen supported at 1,000 stg, followed by 981, while resistance rested at last week's peak of 1,036 and then 1,050, said Adrian Haylor, a technical analyst at Sucden.
"Because we are in the uptrend, maybe that support will hold," he said.
But there were few signs that the market would emerge from the current dull, rangebound trade.
"The moving average is going sideways and the RSI (relative strength indicator) is not giving any signals at all," Haylor said.
